package engine

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// One-time pre-implementation capture. Its exact source is retained with the
// test-first evidence after this generator is removed from the test package.
func TestRasterInputStorageFreezeLegacyJSON(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("WIRE_RASTER_FREEZE_LEGACY") != "1" {
		t.Skip("explicit pre-implementation legacy capture only")
	}
	type entry struct {
		Name  string
		State json.RawMessage
	}
	var cases []entry
	add := func(name string, state ChuWorldState) {
		data, err := json.Marshal(state)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cases = append(cases, entry{name, data})
	}
	add("zero-world", ChuWorldState{})
	visitChuWorldTest(t, func(row chuWorldOriginalPass) {
		if row.Frame == 1800 {
			add("ordinary-first", decodeChuWorldTest(t, row.Before))
		}
	})
	visitChuWorldTest(t, func(row chuWorldOriginalPass) {
		if row.Frame == 1901 || row.Frame == 4054 || row.Frame == 4308 {
			add(string(rune('a'+len(cases)))+"-source7", decodeChuWorldTest(t, row.After))
		}
	}, "chu-world-fighter7-special")
	visitChuWorldTest(t, func(row chuWorldOriginalPass) {
		if row.Frame == 1900 {
			state := decodeChuWorldTest(t, row.After)
			state.DragonBankCursor = 512
			state.DragonHistory[3][8].X = -123
			add("optional-dragon-fields", state)
		}
	}, "chu-world-fighter7-special")
	if len(cases) != 6 {
		t.Fatal("legacy capture selection", len(cases))
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(cases)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var packed bytes.Buffer
	z := gzip.NewWriter(&packed)
	if _, err := z.Write(data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := z.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/raster-input-legacy-worlds.json.gz", packed.Bytes(), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
